description: Use this when a vibescape should be listed in the public gallery, where anybody can find it at vibresia.com/vibescapes. A vibescape is created unlisted; this is the separate act of putting it in front of people. The name and the author go with it, so make sure they are right before calling this.

id.description: The share's id — the last part of the link, six characters. It is what `create_vibescape` returns.

name: share_vibescape
title: Share a vibescape
